M020.by: Sample for the design review, Claude Opus (agent)
M020.summary: PETG here is an unfilled, glycol-modified copolyester, sold as {products} products from {makers} makers. Bars printed flat (XY) give a median tensile strength of {tensileStrengthXY.median} over the {tensileStrengthXY.n} products that state their orientation. Their median elongation at break is {elongationXY.median}. Bars pulled across the layers (Z) give a median tensile strength of {tensileStrengthZ.median}. {hdt045.label} has a median of {hdt045.median} over {hdt045.n} products, and the glass transition a median of {glassTransition.median}. Only {charpyNotched.n} products publish a notched Charpy value on a comparable basis, so its impact behaviour is thinly documented.

M001.by: Sample for the design review, Claude Opus (agent)
M001.summary: PLA here is unfilled polylactic acid, sold as {products} products from {makers} makers. Bars printed flat (XY) give a median tensile modulus of {tensileModulusXY.median} and a median tensile strength of {tensileStrengthXY.median}, over the {tensileStrengthXY.n} products that state their orientation. Their median elongation at break is {elongationXY.median}. {hdt045.label} has a median of {hdt045.median}, close to the median glass transition of {glassTransition.median}. The notched Charpy median of {charpyNotched.median} is of the products not sold as toughened. The products their makers sell as toughened or impact-modified are counted apart from it.

M110.by: Sample for the design review, Claude Opus (agent)
M110.summary: PCTG-GF is a glass-fibre-filled PCTG copolyester, sold as {products} products from {makers} makers, some of which share one data sheet. Its products give a density of {density.median}. Their {hdt045.label} is {hdt045.median}, and their {hdt18.label} is {hdt18.median}. No product states the orientation of its tensile bars, so its tensile values are on file but not compared. Some of its products need a hardened nozzle. Its price in the sample comes from a foreign listing, converted to Canadian dollars.
